subject: maths
question: A rocking chair was sold at a profit of 10%. Had it been sold at ₹80 more, the profit would have been 15%. What is the cost price (in ₹) of the chair?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

According to the question,

5% of CP = ₹80

⇒ CP = 100% = ₹1600

∴ The cost price of the chair is ₹1600.
